title: 카드 영수증 읽기: 얼마를, 어떻게 냈어요?
objective: Read a Korean card receipt to find the item, quantity, discount, amount paid, payment method and date/time, then answer '맞게 계산됐어요?'
summary: A practical guide to reading a Korean card receipt and checking the bill.
note: Keep your receipt until you get home and check it.

task.title: READ AND CHECK RECEIPTS
task.line: Use Receipt B and the key words above to find each piece of information, then decide if the bill is correct.

sections.heading: WHAT THIS IS FOR
paragraphs: Read a Korean card receipt to find the item, quantity, discount, amount paid, payment method and date/time, then answer '맞게 계산됐어요?'

items.gloss: item name, meaning what you bought
the price for that line (item × quantity)
discount, often shown with a minus sign (−)
the amount actually paid, after the discount
how you paid, with 신용카드 (credit card), 체크카드 (debit card) or 현금 (cash)
paying the whole amount at once, not in instalments
instalments, meaning you pay in parts over several months. 3개월 = 석 달 (three months).
date and time of the purchase, often written in 24-hour time
items.example: 거래 일시를 보면 언제 샀는지 알 수 있어요.

sections.heading: 2 / HOW TO CHECK: 맞게 계산됐어요?
paragraphs: Useful sentences: 맞게 계산됐어요. (It was charged correctly.) / 계산이 잘못된 것 같아요. (I think the bill is wrong.) / 우유는 한 개 샀는데 두 개로 찍혔어요. (I bought one milk, but it was rung up as two.)

steps.ko: Step 1: Compare every 품명 and 수량 with what you actually bought.
Step 2: Check that any coupon or sale shows up as 할인.
Step 3: Look at 결제 금액 and 결제 수단 (card type, 일시불 or 할부).

exercises: Look at Receipt B. Write how many apples you bought and how much they cost: 품명: 사과 / 수량: ____ 개 / 금액: ____원
Look at Receipt B. Write the discount and the amount you really paid: 할인: ____원 / 결제 금액: ____원
Look at Receipt B. Circle how this person paid: (신용카드 / 체크카드 / 현금), (일시불 / 할부)
Look at Receipt B. Write the purchase time using 오후 and the 12-hour clock: 2026년 9월 ____일 오후 ____시 ____분
You put these in your basket: 우유 2개, 라면 4개, 사과 3개. Look at Receipt B. 맞게 계산됐어요? Answer 네 or 아니요, and say which item is wrong.
answers: 아니요. 라면 수량이 틀렸어요. (라면은 네 개 샀는데 다섯 개로 찍혔어요.)
